primaries.name: SMG
primaries.desc: Rapid fire; the spread blooms while held, and hits fade past 40 m

primaries.name: Burst
primaries.desc: Three hard, accurate rounds a pull, then a beat

primaries.name: Rifle
primaries.desc: Accurate, with mild bloom and long reach

primaries.name: Gatling
primaries.desc: Spins up while held: opens fire after 0.2 s, from a chug to a torrent, and runs hot

primaries.name: Flak
primaries.desc: A shotgun: eight pellets in a wide cone, brutal up close and fading past 20 m

primaries.name: HEAT
primaries.desc: Hold to charge a burning slug that bursts on impact; charging widens the burst from 1 to 3.5 m and speeds the slug

primaries.name: Grenade rifle
primaries.desc: A drum-fed grenade rifle: three small grenades a second that drop, bounce off what they hit, and burst on a mech or after 1 s

primaries.name: Homing rocket
primaries.desc: Single rockets that curve toward the enemy nearest your crosshair, within 3°, for as long as you keep them there; look away and they fly straight

secondaries.name: Scatter
secondaries.desc: Nine slow flak pellets in a cone, each bursting on contact or at 60 m

secondaries.name: Hellfire
secondaries.desc: Lock-on volley: middle-click locks the enemy nearest your aim within 30° and 150 m in 0.35 s, and the lock holds 2.5 s wherever you look; fire eight slow missiles that fan out wide for 0.2 s, then curve onto it, even round a corner

secondaries.name: Repair torch
secondaries.desc: Hold it on a teammate to mend 10 hp/s, or on an enemy to burn 6 hp/s, out to 28 m; runs warm while held

secondaries.name: Rocket
secondaries.desc: Straight-flying rocket with an 8 m blast

secondaries.name: Rail gun
secondaries.desc: Middle-click toggles the scope; let go of the trigger to fire one fast, flat, heavy slug that punches through shield domes and barriers, wearing them as it passes

secondaries.name: Furnace
secondaries.desc: Heat-fed launcher: throws a fireball, bigger the hotter you run, venting a third of your heat, and fires even overheated

secondaries.name: Grenade launcher
secondaries.desc: Lobbed shell that bounces once or twice, then bursts wide

secondaries.name: Cluster launcher
secondaries.desc: A canister that bursts at its fuse or on a second press into six bomblets that rain down

secondaries.name: Mine layer
secondaries.desc: A sticky mine a second that bursts when an enemy comes within 3.5 m; ten down at most, and middle-click sets them all off

secondaries.name: Pile driver
secondaries.desc: A rocket punch: hold to spool up the spike's booster, let go to fire it. The longer the wind-up, the harder it hits (20, or 55 fully wound) and the farther the booster carries you, up to 12 m: onto an enemy ahead in that range, or else along your aim, up too if you look up. A hit throws them along your aim, a Light farthest, and a wall they slam into hurts too. It fires even overheated, but locks your guns for 0.5 s

offensive.name: Tumbler
offensive.desc: A frag grenade, lobbed: it bounces about, then bursts

offensive.name: Limpet
offensive.desc: A remote mine: thrown, it sticks where it lands, and Q again sets it off; one down at a time

offensive.name: Pall
offensive.desc: A smoke grenade: bursts into a cloud 16 m wide that hides whoever's in or behind it for 10 s

offensive.name: MG turret
offensive.desc: A tripod gun set down ahead for 20 s: it fires short bursts at the nearest enemy it sees within 30 m, until its 25 hull is shot off

offensive.name: Rocket turret
offensive.desc: A tripod launcher set down ahead for 20 s: a rocket every 2 s at the nearest enemy it sees within 45 m, until its 25 hull is shot off

support.name: Brownout
support.desc: An EMP around you: drains enemies' fuel and jams their boost

support.name: Salve
support.desc: Drops a repair orb at your feet, like a wreck's, that only your side can heal from

support.name: Shield dome
support.desc: A half-sphere 21 m across around you for 4 s, or until enemy fire wears off its 150 hull: no shot but a rail slug crosses it either way, whoever fires it, so to hit someone under it you have to walk in or break it; mechs walk through

support.name: Barrier
support.desc: Raises a wall 8 m wide and 8 m tall, 4 m ahead across your aim, for 5 s, or until enemy fire wears off its 200 hull: nothing but a rail slug gets through, either way

abilities.name: Speed boost
abilities.desc: Refills the fuel tank, then 4 s of boost that burns no fuel and runs 25% faster

abilities.name: Vent
abilities.desc: Dump all heat at once, even when overheated

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.desc: 5 s of 40% less damage and 25% more speed on foot, but no boost

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.desc: Up to 6 s all but invisible: no tag, no radar contact, and turrets and bots can't see you. Firing or using an item drops it

abilities.name: Power shot
abilities.desc: Your next shot or volley within 6 s deals 50% more damage (a burst, all of it)

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.desc: 5 s of 25% more damage from everything you fire or throw

abilities.name: Artillery
abilities.desc: 6 s of blasts 30% wider and 10% harder, from everything you fire or throw
